item.title: Guide to the Gardens: Saints vs Newcastle Red Bulls | Northampton Saints
item.description: Northampton Saints return to cinch Stadium at Franklin’s Gardens in the Gallagher PREM for the first time since the Six Nations break this Sturday (21 March, kick-off: 3pm) as they take on the Newcastle Red Bulls.

item.title: Saints name team for Gallagher PREM return against Newcastle | Northampton Saints
item.description: Director of Rugby Phil Dowson has named his Northampton Saints side for the return of the Gallagher PREM this weekend, as Newcastle Red Bulls head to cinch Stadium at Franklin’s Gardens on Saturday (21 March, kick-off: 3pm).

item.title: Matchday Programme // Saints vs Red Bulls | Northampton Saints
item.description: It’s time to get ready for gameday, Saints supporters – the digital matchday programme for Northampton Saints vs Newcastle Red Bulls is available free of charge!

item.title: Match Report: Saints 28-27 Newcastle Red Bulls | Northampton Saints
item.description: Despite a nervy encounter with Newcastle Red Bulls, Northampton Saints re-took their place at the top of the Gallagher PREM standings this weekend with a one-point 28-27 win.

item.title: Hutchinson: Saints ‘pride themselves to be better’ than Newcastle performance | Northampton Saints
item.description: Hutchinson: Saints ‘pride themselves to be better’ than Newcastle performance Liz Tyler Sun, 03/22/2026 - 15:45 Previous Next

item.title: New Saints Stadium Tour dates released for 2026/27 season | Northampton Saints
item.description: Following a series of sold‑out Stadium Tours, Northampton Saints is delighted to announce a fresh set of dates for the 2026/27 season.

item.title: Henry Walker to remain at Saints after signing new contract | Northampton Saints
item.description: Northampton Saints today announce that hooker Henry Walker has signed a new contract to remain at cinch Stadium at Franklin’s Gardens beyond the current campaign.

item.title: This is Belonging: Foundation’s Engage programme supports young people back into education | Northampton Saints
item.description: Round 12 of the Gallagher PREM and Round 16 of the PWR will see PREM Rugby, Premiership Women’s Rugby and their clubs unite for the first time to celebrate inclusivity across the game.

item.title: The 2PM Club Daytime Disco returns to cinch Stadium this summer! | Northampton Saints
item.description: Northampton Saints is excited to announce that The 2PM Club Daytime Disco is returning to cinch Stadium at Franklin’s Gardens this summer following last year’s sold-out event!

item.title: England select four Saints players in U18 Six Nations Festival squad | Northampton Saints
item.description: England head into the 2026 U18 Men’s Six Nations Festival with four Northampton Saints players in their 26-player squad.
